name: 79 Human-Cyborg Relations Droid
description: The 79 Human-Cyborg Relations Droid was produced by Duorq. It was designed to be an entry-level droid, equipped with a TranLang I Communication module and an H9 Droid Brain. H-9PO, a server at the Farrimmer Cafe, was a 79 Human-Cyborg Relations Droid.
